arabic.weightsNote: Guidelines say '4 weights'; Almarai ships Light, Regular, Bold and ExtraBold.

digits.note: Both digit sets appear in the Almarai character set; which one a post uses is a copy decision, not a typography rule.

rendering.requirement: Fonts must be embedded or installed at render time. A fallback to Arial is a validation failure, not a warning.
rendering.currentGap: The current SVG renderer sets font-family='Almarai,Arial,sans-serif' without embedding the font, so server-side and exported renders fall back to Arial.
